title: Daily Rental Amount Paid on Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Claims
content:
**Rule.** The amount per day paid on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts claim rental follows what the loaner cost. It is read from the loaner agreement and its daily rental charges in the Courtesy Transportation Agreements records.
1. Where the loaner was issued under a service-contract allowance with a daily allowance above zero, the amount per day is that daily allowance.
2. Where the holder was charged a daily rental rate below the coverage level's rental amount per day, the amount per day is that daily rate.
3. Otherwise, it is the coverage level's rental amount per day.

| Coverage level | Rental amount per day (USD) |
|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 0.00 |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 35.00 |
| Kessler Shield Select | 40.00 |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 45.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 60.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical rates).**
- A Kessler Shield Preferred holder charged 39.99 a day, below 45.00: the amount per day is 39.99.
- The same holder charged 45.00 a day: not below 45.00, so the amount is 45.00.
- The same holder charged 52.00 a day: 45.00.
- A loaner issued under a service-contract allowance of 33.00 a day: 33.00, whatever the level's figure.
